name: Ricardo Morales
bio:
Ricardo Morales has been immersed in the world of motorsport since his youth, attending races with his father, a mechanic for a local rally team. He began his career in journalism, covering local races for a Santiago newspaper. His sharp writing and keen understanding of the sport quickly led to opportunities in public relations, working for several smaller racing teams before joining Anderson Racing. 

Ricardo's approach to PR is grounded in honesty and transparency. He believes in building genuine relationships with the media and fans alike. He's known for his ability to craft compelling narratives around drivers and teams, even in the face of setbacks. His dedication to authentic storytelling and his deep-rooted passion for Chilean motorsport set him apart.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back, receding hairline
physical.description: Ricardo is a man of average height with a slightly weathered face and a warm smile.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with story ideas.
Insists on having a cup of mate every morning before starting work.
Has a habit of quoting famous motorsport figures during meetings.
